cases.name: channel-budget
cases.decode_command: ffmpeg -v error -xerror -threads 1 -i channel-budget.ts -map 0:a:0 -c:a pcm_f32le -f f32le channel-budget.encoded-96k.f32le
cases.source_definition: Original 48000 Hz PCM16 stereo; seven sinusoidal components at 157,311,617,1223,2441,4871,9743 Hz, phase index*0.19, each amplitude0.078, 96-sample endpoint ramps. Samples0..35999:left-only;36000..71999:right gain0.05; remaining: alternating sides in12000-sample blocks. Quantize round(value*32767).

quantization: Bounded per-band error allocation within one shared element budget; stereo band errors are divided by the corresponding complete channel spectral energy. Mono and zero-energy channels retain their absolute error; packet syntax and budgets are unchanged.
quality_metric: Unweighted source SNR after removing 1024 priming samples and final padding; generated test inputs only.
window_selection: Sine long/start/short/stop with one 1024-sample block of lookahead; per-channel sub-block peak detection and common short-window energy grouping.
zero_band_refinement: After ordinary bounded refinement stalls, search up to four candidates beginning at the exact nearest-magnitude nonzero boundary; retain the existing total move limit and exact channel syntax costs.
